post.description:
Verify an OIDC id_token (JWKS) and mint a PostgreSQL session.

The client (desktop / Admin Console) completes authorization-code + PKCE
S256 against the tenant realm on its own; this endpoint only ever sees the
resulting id_token. No passwords, no ROPC (REQ-SEC-001).

Login rate limiting (REQ-SEC-006): counters live in ops.login_throttle
(cross-tenant, pre-auth — D-DB-14). The IP lock is checked BEFORE any
verification (flood control); the account counter uses only claims that
verified cryptographically, so a forged token cannot steer someone else's
counter. Failures inside the tenant-scoped transaction are recorded in a
separate transaction after the rollback (same pattern as refresh-reuse
detection in service.rotate_refresh).

get.description: Own budget status per level + cutoff flag (REQ-GOV-012).
Filterable audit query within the role scope (REQ-AU-001/002).
CSV/JSON export of the filtered range within the role scope (REQ-AU-003).

post.description:
Verify the tenant's audit hash chain -> ok | broken + seq (REQ-AUD-007).

Every run is itself audited as audit.verified (D-AU-05, REQ-AU-011).

get.description: Global model catalog (provider reference; pricing in USD cents/million).
Effective approved models for the caller (intersection + policy).

post.description: Governance gate for the desktop: 200, or 403 model_not_approved.

get.description:
Key metadata only — the key material was returned exactly once at
issuance and is never exposed again (constitution IV).
Global connector catalog (REQ-CON-001: initial set of 6).
Catalog filtered by the principal's effective policy (REQ-CON-003).

post.description:
Request device enrollment (first-class flow, ADR-013 — no scraping).

The tenant ALWAYS comes from the signed tenant_id claim (D-CP-03); the
org_code is validated against the tenant's slug (D-DEV-02) and only helps
the desktop disambiguate the realm. The enrollment token is returned
EXACTLY ONCE here (ADR-006).
Redeem the enrollment token (one-time). Polls as 202 while pending.
Renew the short-lived device token (session + MFA + ownership).

get.description: Metadata only, scoped by role visibility (REQ-VLT-007).

post.description: Register an encrypted credential -> 201 with the value ONE time.
Rotate -> new value ONE time; the previous value dies (D-VC-05).
Revoke + immediate cutoff of dependent instances (REQ-VLT-005).

Runtime injection channel (REQ-VLT-003): decrypted value to the
credential owner's connector runtime, in memory, audited.

Provision a complete tenant (REQ-ONB-001).

201 on creation; 200 when the slug already exists (idempotent re-run,
no credentials re-delivered). Provider token + tenants.provision.

get.description:
Tenant state (cross-tenant slug lookup via the migrator connection,
state read as trust_app inside the tenant scope — D-ONB-10).
Org overview for org_admin; department overview for dept_admin.

Active grants of an agent (spec 012, REQ-ORG-120) — same manage
gate as POST/DELETE grants; 404 hides existence from anyone else.

Directory within the caller's role scope (no entry permission:
the scope IS the authorization, D-ORG-01).

Any authenticated principal reads branding (the desktop consumes it
at runtime, REQ-BRD-002/003); only org_admin can PUT.
